user.title: Car Thing
user.description: Home Assistant reaches the app through the Docker bridge, usually http://172.30.32.1:8770. The host's loopback will not work.

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.description: Log in so this companion can use your Spotify account. The Car Thing does not receive the token.

connect.title: Log in to Spotify
connect.description:
Click the link below. That opens the Spotify login page. Approve access there.

[Open the Spotify login page]({authorize_url})

After you approve, the browser goes to a page at 127.0.0.1 that fails to load. Copy the full address from the browser bar into **Address from the browser bar**.

auth.title: Log in to Spotify
auth.description: Approve access on the Spotify page, then paste the address the browser tried to open.

reauth_confirm.title: Spotify login expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in again. The new token stays on this companion.

reconfigure.title: Log in to Spotify
reconfigure.description: Continue to open the Spotify login page.

error.cannot_connect: The Bridgething app did not answer. Check that the app is started.
error.invalid_auth: That address did not include a Spotify login code. Copy the full address from the browser bar.
error.oauth_failed: Spotify rejected the login. Open the address again and paste the new redirect.

abort.already_configured: This Car Thing is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The Bridgething app did not answer. It will be tried again when the app starts.
abort.missing_configuration: Add a Spotify application credential first. In the Spotify developer dashboard, set the redirect URI to https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth.
abort.oauth_error: Spotify did not finish the login.

data_description.source: Sound stays on this media player. Its now-playing state is pushed to the screen.

error.cannot_connect: The Bridgething app did not answer.

application_credentials.description: Spotify login no longer uses a developer app. Use Log in to Spotify on the Bridgething setup instead.

set_brightness.name: Set backlight
set_brightness.description: Set the Car Thing backlight from 0 to 100. This switches the panel to manual mode.

value.name: Level
value.description: 0 is the dimmest and 100 is the brightest.

set_brightness_mode.name: Set backlight mode
set_brightness_mode.description: Auto follows the light sensor. Manual uses the backlight level.

navigate.name: Open URL
navigate.description: Load a URL in the device browser.

set_nickname.name: Set nickname
set_nickname.description: Set the name the device advertises.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Wipe the data partition and restart the Car Thing.
